stem: ![](asset:P000330-stem-1)Two blocks of mass 2.9 kg and 1.9 kg are suspended from a rigid support S by two inextensible wires each of length 1 m (see figure). The upper wire has negligible mass and the lower wire has a uniform mass of 0.2 kg/m. The whole system of blocks, wires and support have an upward acceleration of $0.2\ ms^{- 2}$. The acceleration due to gravity is $9.8\ ms^{- 2}$. Find the tension at the mid-point of upper and lower wire?

assets.alt: A 2.9 kg block hanging from a support S by a rope, with a 1.9 kg block hanging below it from a second rope.
